title: VyOS Client configuration warning rules
description: Data-driven rules for the persistent 'configuration warnings' banner (see components/ConfigWarningsBanner.tsx). Each rule's `query` is a JMESPath expression (https://jmespath.org) evaluated against a `facts` object built from already-loaded, typed config (see lib/configWarnings.ts's buildConfigWarningFacts) and MUST evaluate to an array - every element of that array produces one warning, with the element's own fields available for `{fieldName}` interpolation in `id`/`message`. A rule whose condition never matches anything should have a query that evaluates to an empty array, not null/a scalar - see lib/configWarningRules.ts's evaluateConfigWarningRules for how a non-array result is handled (treated as zero matches, logged, never thrown).

id.description: Stable identifier template, not shown to the user - lets the banner key its list and gives tests something stable to assert on. May reference a matched element's own fields as {fieldName} (e.g. "snmp-weak-community-{name}") so multiple matches of the same rule get distinct ids.

query.description: A JMESPath expression evaluated against the facts object (see lib/configWarnings.ts's buildConfigWarningFacts for exactly what's available: rulesets, ssh, https, snmp, users). Must evaluate to an array.

message.description: User-facing warning text, shown in the banner's expanded list. May reference a matched element's own fields as {fieldName}, same as `id`.

description.description: Optional internal note explaining the rule's rationale (e.g. why this is a security concern, or what VyOS behavior it's based on) - never shown to the user, purely for whoever edits this file next.
